long_biography.plain_text:
A 12-day flight to the International Space Station gave Japanese entrepreneur Yusaku Maezawa a second public identity beyond online fashion. Travelling on a Russian Soyuz spacecraft in 2021, he became one of the first self-paying visitors to the station in more than a decade.

Maezawa's fascination with contemporary art provides a longer-running public commitment. He founded the Contemporary Art Foundation to organise exhibitions, awards and grants for emerging artists, while his own collecting achieved international notice through a record-setting Basquiat purchase. Both activities followed Zozotown, the online fashion marketplace he developed from a home mail-order business selling imported records.
